prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of 2008-2015 years of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: External reinsurance to close of the 2008 to 2015 years of account was completed at 31 December 2017, enabling the Syndicate to focus exclusively on open years from 2016 onwards. This contributed to a release of reserves and a fall in the 2017 claims ratio. The gross reduction in outstanding claims due to this RITC was recorded as a movement during 2018.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant gross reserve release of GBP 405.073 million in 2018, primarily due to the external Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of the 2008 to 2015 years of account. This RITC transaction, effective at 31 December 2017, was recorded as a reduction in gross outstanding claims during 2018, allowing the Syndicate to focus on more recent underwriting years. The RITC contributed to a release of reserves and a fall in the 2017 claims ratio. Additionally, 2018 saw the establishment of reserves for current year catastrophe losses including Hurricanes Florence and Michael, and Californian wildfires.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development is dominated by the gross impact of the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of the 2008 to 2015 years of account, which is explicitly recorded as a reduction in gross outstanding claims in the technical provisions note for 2018. This RITC transaction significantly reduced the syndicate's gross liabilities for prior years.
